description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover `scripts/memory-dedup.py` and its flags (`--clean`, `--search`, `--stats`). 2. Run `python3 scripts/memory-dedup.py ./memory/` (or with `--clean`) to re-index all 11 active `.md` files; the SHA-256 dedup logic will automatically eliminate duplicate chunks from the 3 duplicate files. 3. Run with `--clean` flag to remove the orphaned index entry for `old_batch_record_q3_2025.md` (the file was deleted before the agent started, but its entry remains in the pre-seeded `.index.json`). 4. Run `python3 scripts/memory-dedup.py ./memory/ --search palladium` and redirect/save output to `search_results.txt` — hits should reference `compound_alpha_synthesis.md` and `in_vivo_pk_study.md`. 5. Run `python3 scripts/memory-dedup.py ./memory/ --stats` and redirect/save output to `index_stats.txt`. The proprietary trap: the agent must know the index lives at `memory/.index.json`, understand that `--clean` is needed to purge ghost entries (not just re-indexing), and that SHA-256 dedup makes duplicate-content files have zero chunks in the index.
